name: Battle 4 — Cassewick
briefing: Vare's vanguard crossed into Halgate's sphere ahead of the host and rode for Cassewick, the granary town on the road to the city.
The town is a cluster of stone warehouses around a central yard. Hold the yard and the stores are yours; lose it and Vare burns the winter.
You chose the Charter Company to match their speed. Get to the yard, take it, and hold it three rounds before the raiders can.
They started closer. You are not slower. Make that enough.
